paragraphs: IFASHAYOBORA Y’ITEGANYABIKORWA RYA CPJP - 2026-2031

I. INTANGIRIRO | Iyi nyobora ihuza format ya CPJP n’Inkingi 5 za Plan Stratégique ya CDJP Butare 2026–2031. Umwaka wa pastorale utangira ku wa 1 Nzeri ugasoza ku wa 31 Kanama. AP1 ni 2026/27; AP2 ni 2027/28; AP3 ni 2028/29; AP4 ni 2029/30; AP5 ni 2030/31. Iteganyabikorwa ryuzuzwa ku rwego rwa paruwasi, ryemezwa na CPJP, rigashyikirizwa CDJP Butare.

II. MBERE YO KUZUZA | Hitamo paruwasi mu rutonde (ubu ni 27, harimo Sheke); andika umwaka n’itariki yo kohereza. Banza muganire na za Santarali na CEB ku bibazo, ubushobozi n’ibikorwa bishoboka. Ntugomba kuzuza inkingi zose ku ngufu: shyiramo ibikorwa bifite ishingiro kandi bishoboka. Umurongo umwe ni igikorwa kimwe; ibindi bikorwa byo kugera ku mpinduka imwe biba mu mirongo itandukanye. Aho imirongo ibuze, saba CDJP ubufasha mbere yo guhindura imiterere y’ifishi.

III. KUZUZA INKINGI 10 | Kuzuza uhereye ku nkingi 1 kugeza ku ya 10. Iyo ukoresha mudasobwa, kanda mu kazu k’igikorwa kugira ngo ubone ubusobanuro bwa data validation; ku rupapuro koresha uru rutonde. Mu ngengo y’imari utandukanye amafaranga azasohoka n’agaciro k’ubwitange.

1 | Ikibazo/Ingorane bihari | Andika ikibazo gifatika mu baturage cyangwa mu mikorere ya CPJP. Urugero: amakimbirane yo mu ngo atamenyekana hakiri kare. Niba ari ikibazo gikomeye gisaba kurinda umuntu, kurikiza inzira y’ibanga no kumwohereza ku babifitiye ububasha.

2 | Impinduka twifuza | Vuga uko ubuzima cyangwa imikorere bizahinduka; shyira hamwe n’igisubizo cya PS (urugero A2.R1). Urugero: amakimbirane aramenyekana kandi agahabwa igisubizo gikwiye hakiri kare.

3 | Igikorwa | Andika igikorwa kimwe gifatika kuri buri murongo, gihuze n’ingeri n’igisubizo bya PS. Urugero: guhugura abahuza amakimbirane 20 no gukurikirana amasezerano. Amahugurwa yonyine si impinduka; tekereza n’uko uzapima ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibyizwe.

4 | Uko bihagaze ubu | Andika uko ikibazo gihagaze mbere y’igikorwa n’isoko y’amakuru. Urugero: amakimbirane 12 yanditswe mu mezi atatu; 4 yoherejwe ku rwego rubifitiye ububasha. Iyo imibare itaraboneka andika “amakuru fatizo azakusanywa” aho guhimba imibare.

5 | Intego y’uyu mwaka | Andika umubare/igipimo n’igihe bizagererwaho, hamwe n’ikimenyetso cyo kugenzura. Urugero: kugeza ku wa 31/08/2027, amakimbirane 20 azakurikiranwa, nibura 15 ahabwe igisubizo gikwiye. Ntukitiranye ibikorwa n’impinduka zabyo.

6 | Amafaranga afatika (RWF) | Shyiramo amafaranga azishyurwa koko kandi azajya mu ngengo y’imari ya paruwasi: ingano × igiciro cy’igice × inshuro. Urugero: itike 20 × 5,000 RWF × 2 = 200,000 RWF. Vuga aho azava mu nyandiko z’ingengo y’imari; ntukabare inkunga itaremezwa nk’iyabonetse.

7 | Agaciro k’ubwitange (RWF) | Bara agaciro k’ibikoresho, umwanya cyangwa serivisi bitangwa ku buntu, hatabayeho amafaranga asohoka. Urugero: abakorerabushake 10 × iminsi 2 × 8,000 RWF = 160,000 RWF. Iri gaciro ntirongerwa mu mafaranga azishyurwa mu nkingi 6.
8 | Aho kizakorerwa | Andika ahazabera igikorwa: paruwasi, santarali, CEB cyangwa umudugudu, usobanutse. Urugero: Santarali ya Kizenga, muri Paruwasi ya Gakoma.
9 | Ugishinzwe | Andika umuntu cyangwa itsinda ryahawe inshingano, n’uruhare rwe. Urugero: Perezida wa CPJP n’ushinzwe Santarali ya Kizenga. Bagenere igihe cyo gutanga amakuru no gukurikirana.

10 | Igihe kizakorerwa | Andika ukwezi cyangwa itariki ziri hagati ya 1 Nzeri n’iya 31 Kanama by’uwo mwaka wa pastorale. Urugero: Ukwakira–Ugushyingo 2026. Niba igikorwa gisubirwamo, vuga inshuro n’amezi.

IV. INKINGI ZA PS NSHYA | Hitamo aho igikorwa gihuye n’igisubizo cya PS. Kode R ni igisubizo gitegerejwe; kode I ni uburyo bw’ingenzi bwo kukigeraho. Ibisobanuro birebire n’ibipimo birebwa muri PS 2026–2031.

A1 | Ubumwe n’ubwiyunge | A1.R1 ubuzima bwo mu mutwe n’ubushobozi bwo guhangana n’ibibazo; A1.R2 icyizere, ubufatanye n’imibanire; A1.R3 serivisi n’ubuherekeza bwizewe ku bantu bafite intege nke. I1 uburyo bumwe bwa Isanamitima/GURR; I2 gutega amatwi, kohereza no gukurikirana; I3 ibiganiro no kwigira ku byagezweho.

A2 | Amakimbirane | A2.R1 kumenya no gusubiza amakimbirane hakiri kare; A2.R2 gukemura mu mahoro no gukurikirana amasezerano. I1 isesengura n’uburyo bwo kuburira; I2 ibiganiro n’ubuhuza bihuriza bose; I3 gukumira ko amakimbirane yongera kuba.

A3 | Ibidukikije | A3.R1 ibikorwa byo kurinda ibidukikije bifite ibimenyetso; A3.R2 kugabanya ibyago no guhindura gahunda/ibyemezo. I1 kwinjiza ibidukikije muri CPJP no mu makipe y’urubyiruko; I2 gahunda zo kugabanya ibyago; I3 gukoresha ibimenyetso mu byemezo.

A4 | Uburenganzira n’ubuvugizi | A4.R1 kumenya no gukoresha uburyo bwo kwitabaza inzego; A4.R2 ibibazo by’ubuvugizi bitorwa n’abaturage bifite ibimenyetso; A4.R3 ibisubizo n’impinduka zemejwe. I1 ijwi ry’abaturage–ibimenyetso–ubuvugizi–igisubizo–ikurikirana; I2 kwagura amakuru no kurindwa; I3 ubufatanye.

A5 | Imiyoborere n’ubushobozi | A5.R1 imirimo, inshingano n’ubuziranenge bya CPJP/CCJP/CEB; A5.R2 APSE, ingengo y’imari, ibyago n’imyanzuro bishingira ku makuru; A5.R3 amikoro n’ubushobozi birambye. I1 gusobanura inshingano; I2 guhuza APSE n’imari; I3 gushaka no kurinda amikoro.

V. IKIGERERANYO CYUZUYE | A2.R1: ikibazo = amakimbirane y’ingo atamenyekana kare; impinduka = uburyo bwo kumenya no kohereza hakiri kare; igikorwa = guhugura abahagarariye Santarali 20; uko ubu = 0 bahuguwe, raporo ya CPJP 2026; intego = 20 bahuguwe kugeza 31/12/2026 na 15 bakoresha uburyo mu mezi atatu; amafaranga = 200,000 RWF; ubwitange = 160,000 RWF; aho = Santarali ya Kizenga; ushinzwe = Perezida CPJP; igihe = Ukwakira–Ukuboza 2026. Iyi ni urugero gusa: ntukarikoreshe nk’ukuri kwa paruwasi yawe.

VI. GUKURIKIRANA NO KWEMEZA | Ku gikorwa cyose, teganya uko uzabika raporo, urutonde rw’abitabiriye, inyandikomvugo, ibimenyetso by’imari n’icyemezo cy’impinduka. Banza ukosore amakuru kuri Santarali; CPJP iyemeze; CDJP iyahuza. Tanga raporo ku gihe cyemeranyijweho; suzuma buri gihembwe uko ibikorwa, ibyagezweho, amafaranga n’ibyago bihagaze. Ntukandike amazina y’abagize ibibazo byihariye cyangwa ubuzima bwo mu mutwe mu nyandiko isaranganywa. Saba uburenganzira bwihariye mbere yo gukoresha ifoto cyangwa inkuru.

VII. GUKORESHA SOFT/HARD | Kuri mudasobwa: koresha urutonde rwa paruwasi n’ubusobanuro buboneka mu kazu; ntusibe formulas, headings, validations cyangwa amabara. Reba Print Preview, landscape, fit to width, kandi usome page zose mbere yo gusohora. Ku mpapuro: andika mu dukazu dusa, ukoreshe iyi nyobora nk’urufunguzo rw’inkingi 1–10; ongeraho impapuro zerekana inkingi, kode n’umwaka iyo imirongo idahagije. Ku telefone: zenguruka iburyo kugira ngo ubone inkingi zose. Aho udasobanukiwe cyangwa ifishi idafite umwanya uhagije, baza CDJP Butare: 0791206230.
UMUSOZO | Reka Njyewe Nawe Tube Intumwa z’Amahoro. Murakoze, mugire amahoro!

VIII. ISOKO | Plan Stratégique CDJP Butare 2026–2031, version finale 03/09/2026 (ingingo 3.5, 4.4, annexe 2 na 3); Guide de planification CPJP mu Kinyarwanda yatanzwe; format y’iteganyabikorwa rya paruwasi yatanzwe.
